---
name: Rule request
about: A domain is routed the wrong way, or a service is missing
title: "[Rule] "
labels: rule-request
---

**Domain**
e.g. `example.com`

**Expected routing**
DIRECT (China) / Proxy / Streaming / AI / Telegram / REJECT — pick one, and say why if it is not obvious.

**App or website**
Which app or site does this domain belong to?

**What goes wrong today**
e.g. "The app fails to load on DIRECT" or "It goes through the proxy and hits a region lock".
